content: अज्ञ {%a.%} [न जानाति, ज्ञा-क. <sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Not knowing, unaware of, unconscious, devoid of knowledge or experience; अज्ञो भवति वै बालः <ls>Ms. 2. 153</ls>; ज्ञाज्ञौ (ज्ञः ईश्वरः अज्ञः जीवः) the knowing and unknowing, supreme and individual soul. .²2 Ignorant, unwise, foolish, silly, stupid (said of men as well as animals); अज्ञः सुखमाराध्यः <ls>Bh. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2. 3</ls>. .²3 Inanimate; not endowed with the power of understanding (अचेतन..)
